supervisory_authorities.dpa: Federal Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (BfDI)
supervisory_authorities.csirt: CERT-Bund / Federal Office for Information Security (BSI)

statutory_frameworks.official_title: Gesetz uber das Bundesamt fur Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik (BSI-Gesetz, BSIG) as amended by NIS-2-Umsetzungs- und Cybersicherheitsstarkungsgesetz (NIS2UmsuCG)
statutory_frameworks.supervisory_authority: Bundesamt fur Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik (BSI)

metadata.kritis_scope: Energy, Water, Food, Health, Finance, Insurance, IT/Telecom, Transport, Municipal Waste

statutory_frameworks.supervisory_authority: Der Bundesbeauftragte fur den Datenschutz und die Informationsfreiheit (BfDI) and State DPAs

metadata.special_provisions: Employee data protection section 26 BDSG, video surveillance section 4 BDSG

cyber_security_mandates.target_domain: KRITIS & Particularly Important Entities (Besonders wichtige Einrichtungen)
cyber_security_mandates.baseline_standard_ref: BSI IT-Grundschutz / BSI TR-02102 / IEC 62443 / ISO/IEC 27001
cyber_security_mandates.mandatory_certifications: Section 8a BSIG Audit Certification every 2 years; mandatory Systeme zur Angriffserkennung (SzaE / Attack Detection Systems)
cyber_security_mandates.details: KRITIS operators must operate qualified attack detection systems with automated log inspection. Management board bears direct personal liability for implementation.

data_privacy_sovereignty.supervisory_dpa: Federal Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (BfDI)
data_privacy_sovereignty.localization_scope: No general localization within EU/EEA. Transfers outside EEA strictly conditional under Chapter V.
data_privacy_sovereignty.cross_border_transfer_mechanism: Adequacy Decisions (Art 45), Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs, Art 46), Binding Corporate Rules (BCRs, Art 47), Derogations (Art 49)

cryptography_controls.crypto_export_controls: EU Dual-Use Regulation (EU) 2021/821 Annex I Category 5 Part 2 (Information Security). Wassenaar Arrangement member.
cryptography_controls.approved_encryption_standards: AES-256, RSA >= 3072, ECC (NIST P-256/P-384, Ed25519), BSI TR-02102-1, SOG-IS Agreed Cryptographic Mechanisms
cryptography_controls.post_quantum_mandate: BSI Technical Guideline TR-02102-1 and ANSSI PQC migration recommendation: hybrid post-quantum key encapsulation (ML-KEM / Kyber) required for long-term secure communications by 2026-2030.

incident_disclosure_rules.breach_type: Significant Incident in KRITIS / Essential Entity
incident_disclosure_rules.threshold_trigger_definition: Section 8b BSIG: Any malfunction, breakdown, or significant security breach affecting KRITIS services or digital infrastructure.

sector_applicability.specific_obligations: Generation, transmission, distribution, and pipeline SCADA integrity.
Water treatment, distribution telemetry, and environmental control.
Hospital systems, medical device cybersecurity, and EHR data protection.
Payment systems, banking core networks, and cyber resilience audits.
Public telecommunications networks, submarine cables, and 5G security.
Machinery safety, industrial robotics, PLC programming, and safety instrumented systems.
Rail signaling, air traffic management, maritime port terminals, and connected vehicles.
